en.summary: Recent releases bring powerful new capabilities for monitoring cloud databases and on-premises environments. Aurora PostgreSQL clusters now provide unified visibility with detailed metrics and automatic instance monitoring, while individual query execution monitoring extends to Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and Google Cloud SQL for SQL Server. The Virtual Machines page is now production-ready, delivering per-disk performance details and cost analysis across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud. Enterprise customers gain new security controls including database permission change alerts powered by SQL Audit, while the modernized Analysis page now offers improved performance and an intuitive user experience.

highlights: Aurora PostgreSQL cluster monitoring now displays detailed metrics about DB instances and cluster events in one view, with automatic monitoring of both writer and reader instances
Individual query execution monitoring is now available for Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and Google Cloud SQL for SQL Server
SQL Audit is now out of preview in Enterprise edition, enabling comprehensive audit trail monitoring
Virtual Machines page is now out of preview with per-disk performance details including space used, capacity, and I/O metrics
Google Cloud SQL monitoring is now available for PostgreSQL instances
Virtual Machines page now shows SQL Server instances running on each machine with version and edition details
Enterprise edition now includes new alert type for database permission changes when SQL Audit is enabled
Google Cloud SQL monitoring is now available for SQL Server instances
Virtual Machines page now shows average network throughput metrics for each machine
Availability group topology is now retained for up to 24 hours after a monitoring gap, reducing false alerts
Built-in REST API documentation now features a faster, fully searchable interface for exploring and testing endpoints
Built-in REST API documentation has a new interface that is faster and fully searchable for easier endpoint exploration and testing
SQL Agent job monitoring is now available for Contained Availability Groups with job definitions, history, and activity tracked
Disk Usage page now caches data for faster load times on subsequent refreshes
Native ServiceNow and Microsoft Teams notifications are now out of preview
Individual query execution monitoring is now available for Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance
Limited sampling databases now show an amber status with specific error messages instead of being silently ignored
PostgreSQL query plan history now distinguishes plans using different indexes, making index changes visible
Linux CPU metrics now exclude I/O wait time for more accurate utilization reporting
Enterprise edition adds new server role membership change alerts to track privilege changes
Query Executions tab now shows tempdb spill counts for each query
Effective costs added to Virtual Machines page alongside billed costs
AWS EC2 instance cost details are now visible on the Virtual Machines page with daily cost graphs and comparison capabilities
PostgreSQL Aurora reader instances can now be automatically monitored via the cluster
Alert types now allow databases to be excluded by name for more granular alert control
Azure virtual machine cost details are now visible on the Virtual Machines page
AI Alert analysis is now available for Long-running query, Deadlock, and Blocking process alerts
Azure virtual machine subscription details are now displayed on the Virtual Machines page
Enterprise edition adds SQL Audit file rollover alerts to detect missed audit events
Custom metric alert details from secondary queries are now included in script and webhook notifications
Disk read and write latency metrics are now available for Amazon RDS hosts on the Analysis page
SQL Server query plans now display instance origin information in modals and tabs
New Analysis graph experience is now the default with improved performance, better user experience, and modern design
Index sampling is now enabled by default for all PostgreSQL instances
Blocking process alerts now include system processes
Added Machine processor time metric for Linux hosts that excludes hypervisor steal time
AI analysis support added for MongoDB Top queries
Top waits data is now available for PostgreSQL on server overview and database details pages
PostgreSQL tracked queries are now available from the database overview page
Custom metric alerts now include optional secondary query results for additional context
Availability Group page now shows backup priority for each replica
Current activity pages with AI capability are now available for Oracle and MySQL instances
Virtual Machines page now displays cloud resource details for Azure VMs with appropriate cloud credentials
Microsoft Teams notifications now include a link to the alert in Monitor
All notification types can now be rate limited to prevent notification overload
Enterprise edition: New SQL Audit tab available in preview on the Security page to track permission changes
Availability Group overview page now displays a Readable Secondary column showing secondary replica read capabilities
Support added for monitoring PostgreSQL instances on virtual machines in the Virtual Machines page
Ability to add SQL Server instances on previously added Linux machines
AI-powered query analysis now supports Oracle and MySQL instances alongside SQL Server and PostgreSQL
Tags can now be applied to SQL Server and PostgreSQL databases for alert suppression and filtering
Certificate authentication for monitoring Linux PostgreSQL servers is now in preview
PostgreSQL 18 support is now available
Custom text can be added to alert email notifications
Monitoring of MySQL instances running on AWS Aurora is now supported
Enterprise Edition: Permissions monitoring is now available for Azure Managed Instances
Custom metrics and alerts are now available for PostgreSQL
Estate Virtual Machines page added to monitor virtual machine usage across cloud and on-premises
Analysis page updated with new modern design
New alert types for Replication job failure and Replication maintenance job failure added for SQL Server
Native ServiceNow integration now allows ServiceNow incidents to be raised when alerts occur
Native Microsoft Teams integration added for alert notifications
MySQL monitoring support added for Azure Flexible Server
Oracle Data Guard monitoring support extended
Enterprise edition: Ability to export all sysadmins, serveradmins, and securityadmins across all servers
Query Executions page now shows Memory Grants associated with each query

de.summary: Aktuelle Versionen bringen leistungsstarke neue Funktionen für die Überwachung von Cloud-Datenbanken und lokalen Umgebungen. Aurora PostgreSQL-Cluster bieten jetzt einheitliche Transparenz mit detaillierten Metriken und automatischer Instanzüberwachung, während die Überwachung einzelner Abfrageausführungen auf Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance und Google Cloud SQL für SQL Server erweitert wurde. Die Virtual Machines-Seite ist nun produktionsreif und liefert Pro-Datenträger-Leistungsdetails und Kostenanalysen über Azure, AWS und Google Cloud. Enterprise-Kunden erhalten neue Sicherheitskontrollen, einschließlich Warnungen zu Datenbankberechtigungsänderungen mit SQL Audit, während die modernisierte Analysis-Seite jetzt verbesserte Leistung und eine intuitive Benutzeroberfläche bietet.

highlights: Die Überwachung von Aurora PostgreSQL-Clustern zeigt jetzt detaillierte Metriken zu DB-Instanzen und Clusterereignissen in einer Ansicht, mit automatischer Überwachung von Writer- und Reader-Instanzen
